verdict.rationale: Gemini documents persistent instruction mechanisms, but each is scoped or implicit rather than a global setting. Custom Gems are built from your stated requirements, notebooks remember your instructions within a project, and personalization draws on memory of past chats. None of the evidence shows an explicit, account-wide custom-instructions or preferences setting that applies to every response. missing for 10: documented global custom instructions/saved preferences applied to all chats, controls for editing stored preferences, independent or hands-on corroboration that instructions persist across sessions.
